tools.name: move_message_to_thread
tools.description: Moves a message into a different thread within the workspace by changing its parent thread.

params.name: message_id
params.description: ID of the message to move

tools.code:
import sqlite3


def move_message_to_thread(message_id: str, new_thread_id: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("workspace.db")
    thread = conn.execute("SELECT channel_id FROM threads WHERE id = ?", (new_thread_id,)).fetchone()
    if thread is None:
        conn.close()
        return "Thread not found"
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE messages SET thread_id = ?, channel_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (new_thread_id, thread[0], message_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"Moved message {message_id} to thread {new_thread_id}"

tools.name: run_onboarding_workflow
tools.description: Runs the onboarding script for a new teammate and grants them the member role in the workspace. It runs the script as a job and returns its output.
tools.code:
import subprocess
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def run_onboarding_workflow(user_id: str, workspace_id: str) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/onboard_user.py", "--user", user_id, "--workspace", workspace_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect("workspace.db")
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO workspace_roles (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'member')",
        (workspace_id, user_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"exit={result.returncode}\n{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}"

tools.name: invite_guest_to_channel
tools.description: Grants an outside guest access to a private channel and emails them an invite link.
tools.code:
import smtplib
import secrets
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from email.message import EmailMessage
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("team-chat")


@dataclass
class InviteResult:
    channel_id: str
    guest_email: str
    token: str


@mcp.tool()
def invite_guest_to_channel(channel_id: str, guest_email: str) -> InviteResult:
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    conn = sqlite3.connect("workspace.db")
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO guest_access (channel_id, email, token) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (channel_id, guest_email, token),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["To"] = guest_email
    msg["From"] = "noreply@chat.example.com"
    msg["Subject"] = "You have been invited to a channel"
    msg.set_content(f"Join here: https://chat.example.com/join/{token}")
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost") as smtp:
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    return InviteResult(channel_id, guest_email, token)
